rounding_theorem.domain: Per-real-component sup norm; all dyadic query/scatter operations considered exact for this incremental bound.
rounding_theorem.division_error: Each of the eight query divisions has additive error e_k with |e_k|<delta for truncation to output grid delta.
rounding_theorem.source_error: -K e, componentwise absolute error < delta because ||K||_infty=1.
rounding_theorem.target_error: J K e=-13 K e, componentwise absolute error <13 delta.
rounding_theorem.noninterference: R_i K_j=0 for i!=j, so earlier exact dyadic scatters, including division error, do not change later source query rows.
rounding_theorem.four_extra_fraction_bits: delta=2^(-p-4) implies added target error <(13/16)*2^-p; source error <(1/16)*2^-p.
rounding_theorem.input_accumulator_bound: Every completed query is bounded by 56B; every accumulator prefix including earlier division errors is bounded by 56B+(9/2)delta. Six integer guard bits suffice when B>=delta.
rounding_theorem.scope_limit: Rounding in other arithmetic and inherited recursive native calls is additional and must enter a complete precision recurrence.
